THE PERSON BEHIND THE PROJECT

Hansam Yang

Project founder, responsible editor and publisher of Hansam Bible.

Hansam Yang initiated this project to trace the earliest recoverable biblical text and make evidence-aware readings available across languages. The pilot collection is produced with AI assistance. The name identifies the modern editorial project, not authorship of the ancient biblical texts.

AI assistance is disclosed. External Hebrew, textual-critical and native-language review is pending; no human specialist approval or institutional endorsement is claimed.

A project built to be checked

Read the evidence, inspect the data, and challenge the decisions. A reported variant remains distinct from a directly verified manuscript reading. Corrections are versioned.
